run_deprecated_grpc_check: run the sanity check script to verify deprecated grpc++ headers match expected shim content
check_grpc_header_list: check that the list of deprecated grpc++ header files matches the expected file list
validate_grpc_shim_headers: validate each deprecated grpc++ header file matches the generated shim template with correct include guards
scan_src_for_deprecated_includes: scan source files in src/ for invalid includes of deprecated grpc++ headers
review_deprecated_grpc_script: review the check_deprecated_grpc++ script to understand how it validates deprecated gRPC C++ header shim files
